summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (JTM 1.2/4)

data.translation: Sie hüllen ihn in ein Leichentuch, wobei das Wehklagen weitergeht.

rationale: New II Infectum box: plural attendants and -le deceased patient in an ongoing funeral sequence.

summary: New box Part. Pass.: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (JTM 1.2/6)

data.turoyo: Kmaḥti u tabut bi naḥšo, d lowe b tabut naqqa ḥreto, kmaḥti u miṯo, huwe mkafno, bi naḥšo.
data.translation: Sie stellen den Sarg auf die Bare, und wenn der (Tote) keinen Sarg hat, dann legen sie den in Leichentücher gehüllten Toten direkt auf die Bare.

rationale: New Detransitive Part. Pass. box and explicit state sense: mkafno describes the deceased, with no expressed shrouder.

summary: New sense 1: (Detrans.) in ein Leichentuch gehüllt sein
rationale: mkafno predicates the shrouded state of the deceased; one clear Part. Pass. attestation extends the active shrouding meaning.

data.translation: Nachdem sie ihn in das Leichentuch gehüllt haben, bringen sie die Bare. <...>

rationale: Thin II Preterit cell: completed shrouding precedes bringing the bier; plural attendants contrast with inherited singular.

summary: Keep the homonym kfn 2 distinct from kfn 1. Arabic-derived shrouding is a lexical funeral verb, not a light-verb construction simply because its source is denominative.
JTM 1.2/4-6 contrasts ongoing plural shrouding kəmkafnile, anterior completed mkafanne, and resultant mkafno predicated of the deceased. No additional stem is needed.
Active patients are pronominal or recoverable from the funeral sequence; the cloth is lexically implied or named immediately before the verb at 25/53.
The JTM 1.2/6 supplied German continues beyond the Turoyo row into church/service details. The addition quotes only the securely matching first sentence, retaining Bare exactly as printed.
The already quoted 25/53 occurrence remains once in the Preterit box.
Confirm the precise plural-agent/patient segmentation of mkafanne in JTM 1.2/5, and the relation of Part. Pass. mkafno to the citation Infectum mkafən.
Reconcile the excess German church/service material after the cemetery in JTM 1.2/6 with the edition's verse boundary; it was excluded from the added example.
